q1_issues.issue: The possessed plural "his ... apologies" is encoded as one singular witness (Member sk_apology_1 apology) instead of the group witness a definite/possessed plural takes.
"sincere" is predicated of that single witness, so the descriptive modifier never distributes over the several apologies the plural names.
LocatedIn positions event-denoting referents ("events at Foodservice"); the head split reserves LocatedIn for things and gives eventualities the Location oblique.
"elsewhere" is dropped — the atom simply says the events are located in the group, losing the "at places other than Foodservice" content, and repeats the LocatedIn-on-events head error.

q2_gaps: the locative pro-form "elsewhere" — an unnamed place plus exclusion of the place just named
scare quotes around a quoted phrase inside a sentence ("sincere apologies") — no carrier records that the wording is being attributed rather than endorsed

a pre-nominal occupational title ("Board Chairman Henny de Ruiter"): the courtesy-title rule folds a title into the Name string while the appositive rule makes it a host-tensed typing atom, and nothing says which governs a false title
notes: Name with internal lowercase particle, board_chairman genus with the noun modifier unexposed, offer roles (Agent/Recipient/Theme), the For-oblique on the apology noun, and the un-fused "embattled group" are all right. "at the meeting" is read as the offering's Location rather than a post-modifier of "shareholders", which is the reasonable favored reading, not a tie.
